paragraphs: That evening, everyone enjoys a bowl of soup by the campfire and goes to sleep. The next morning, Dre’Kaar takes the watch and circles the camp on a huge beetle. From the air, Dre’Kaar suddenly spots a band of orcs approaching the camp from the right.

Three little messenger beetles are tucked inside the Commander Beetle’s abdomen. Dre’Kaar gives each beetle an order and names the person who must carry it out. Latve is to wake everyone, Faelina is to set the traps, and Narion is to move from the left flank to the right lookout. The messengers fan out across the camp.
As soon as Narion reaches the right lookout, the orcs in front of him pull back. From the air, Dre’Kaar sees the main group of orcs closing in from the left and calls Narion back to his old post.
imageAlt: Dre’Kaar riding a large beetle with golden wings
task: Build the class diagram for the three orders. Show how Dre’Kaar hands them to the Commander Beetle and how each order delegates work to its receiver.
steps: Identify the client, invoker, commands, and receivers
Connect the invoker to Command and each concrete order to its receiver
Execute Narion’s order, then undo it to restore his previous post
